Both periods were previously exposed and are not fresh or independent confirmation.

authorized_actions: download missing official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT 1m quote_volume and taker_buy_quote_volume data
prepare and quality-check all required inputs with causal warm-up
predict and score frozen procedures A/B/C/D on both approved periods using this protocol

periods.prior_exposure: Previously used in repository model comparisons; historical robustness only, not independent confirmation.
Prior historical holdout results and overlapping BTC observations were viewed; historical robustness only, not unseen validation.

protocol.bundle_hash_record: The pre_read_manifest.json stores hashes for every model, transform, procedure manifest, source dataset, code path, and development-cache array before protected-row values are read.
protocol.common_mask: market start in exact window; Opened+7m label availability strictly before that window's exclusive end; binary label and finite BASE70, memory, and all three ESN PCA8 features

cost_reference.future_score_runtime: Estimated 3-5 minutes of CPU scoring for roughly 105,000 confirmation and 28,000 holdout decisions, based on the measured 2.66M-row dynamic replay and 52,120-row synthetic bootstrap benchmark; add filesystem-dependent source hashing and Parquet input I/O, not benchmarked on protected inputs.
cost_reference.protected_source_hashing: Hashes are verified only after the immutable pre-read manifest is written; hashing cost is input-I/O and is not included in development feature timings.

protocol.ensemble: equal weight within every frozen LightGBM/reservoir seed member
protocol.exclusions: report sequential counts for out-of-window market starts, unavailable/nonbinary labels, invalid BASE70, and invalid dynamic representations
protocol.fixed_subperiods: UTC calendar months, reported for every month intersecting each window, including partial October 2026; never select dates by results.
protocol.interpretation: historical robustness of previously exposed periods; no inference about profitability
protocol.model_source: existing fit-core bundles; no refit, tuning, or early stopping
protocol.multiple_comparison_correction: Bonferroni familywise alpha 0.05 across only the two prespecified primary comparisons; report 97.5% two-sided percentile intervals for each. No correction for prior search history.
protocol.resume_and_retention: Each invocation appends attempts.json; pre_read_manifest.json is immutable; period checkpoints are checksum-verified and never overwritten; failed attempts remain in the same identity directory.
